# Kestrel Relay

> Kestrel Relay delivers SMS and voice notifications through one HTTP API.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://kestrelrelay.example/docs/quickstart): send a first message
- [API keys](https://kestrelrelay.example/docs/api-keys): create and rotate keys
- [Delivery receipts](https://kestrelrelay.example/docs/delivery-receipts): webhook events for sent, delivered, and failed
